title: Pixel Index custom pet manifest
description: Shape of the manifest.json inside a custom-pet upload zip for POST /api/v1/assets?assetKind=pet (#105). Mirrors services/api/src/assets/decodePet.ts's manifest validation field-for-field: only id and name are checked, and unknown properties are not rejected. See docs/custom-asset-zip-contract.md for the zip-level rules (the <id>/{manifest.json,pet.png} layout, the 96x96 PNG frame grid) this schema doesn't cover.

id.description: Uppercase letters, digits, underscore, starting with a letter. This is the requested asset id — pixel-index suffixes it (_2, _3, ...) on collision. Upstream itself drops this field once the pet reaches the client; pixel-index keeps it for GET /api/v1/assets/:assetId.
